Upstream: https://github.com/atomicobject/heatshrink
Commit: 7d419e1fa4830d0b919b9b6a91fe2fb786cf3280
Version reported by heatshrink_common.h: 0.4.1
License: ISC; see LICENSE in this directory.

Vendored files: heatshrink_common.h, heatshrink_config.h,
heatshrink_encoder.h, heatshrink_encoder.c,
heatshrink_decoder.h, heatshrink_decoder.c, LICENSE.

Local configuration changes only:
- HEATSHRINK_DYNAMIC_ALLOC defaults to 0.
- HEATSHRINK_USE_INDEX is 0.
Static window bits 8, lookahead bits 4 and decoder input buffer 32 are
upstream defaults. The wrapper rejects incompatible build settings.

Compile/link both .c files with the application. For an Arduino sketch,
the build must place these C files in a compiled sketch/source directory;
placing the original vendor directory next to the sketch is insufficient.
